name: Ninja Unfettered Ninja
body:
The unfettered ninja eschews their armor and poison use to focus on the ability to dodge and maneuver.

Unfettered Defense (Ex)

At 1st level, a unfettered ninja gains the AC bonus of a monk of their ninja level.

This ability replaces the proficiency with light armor and poison use.
